parts.note: One exact-path coverage obligation for supplied change sets with a recorded declaration. Includes deletions, both coverage alternatives and the generated-output exclusion. Missing input routes to the required sibling.
One fail-closed obligation for absent input with a recorded declaration. It needs no observable changed path; empty input is correctly distinguished as permitting.

graph.note: The sole original mandatory, critical, internal start-to-start runs_alongside relationship to planner.docs.artifact-path-shape is remapped through edgeRemap to cover-docs-paths, preserving its original relationship specification. Mutual requires edges keep absent-change-set delivered with coverage, so neither part is orphaned and the original conjunction survives.

audit.summary: The split preserves coverage and fail-closed input handling without new waivers or obligations. Observer descriptions and placeholder examples do not narrow scope or overfit an application. Mechanical checks pass and substantive review finds no net change.

parts.risk: Low. The weak-agent fields clearly scope the rule to a recorded declaration and supplied change set, include added, modified, and deleted paths, exclude docs/dist/**, and require exact equality with either an artifact path or an archive from. They also distinguish empty input and route absent input to the sibling. Satisfying this part alone could miss fail-closed absent-input handling, but the mutual requires edges preserve the source's joint mandate.

Low. The weak-agent fields unambiguously distinguish absent input (COULD_NOT_CHECK and blocks) from empty input (permits), prohibit claiming nothing is undeclared without input, and defer the no-declaration case to core. Its dependency on the coverage part is explicit through requires edges.

review.summary: Independent segment-by-segment review found no dropped or unaccounted source content. The shared strict-disposition node preserves fail-on-every-finding behavior, including no advisory mode or ratchet baseline. Coverage, exact-path matching, archive-from handling for deletions, generated-output and no-declaration exceptions, empty-versus-absent input behavior, severity, remediation, and anti-patterns are all retained without a new obligation. Each part has one distinct activation and obligation; mutual requires edges prevent either from being treated as the whole source rule. The original runs_alongside edge is sensibly remapped to the coverage part, and the source alias resolves to both parts.
